description.value:
Not every operative fits neatly into one specialty, and Maverick Practice adepts turn that refusal to specialize into their greatest strength. Drawing on a broad grab-bag of combat tricks, they adapt mid-fight, finding the unconventional answer the moment a conventional one fails.

What defines a Maverick isn't a single signature move but sheer versatility, the confidence to try something nobody expected, backed by just enough raw skill to make it work.
